art_direction: 浅蓝灰底雾紫双眼，间距稍近，共同左望。
composition_variation: Bring the two bowls modestly closer without crowding them. The left opening is eighteen percent shallower and two percent lower, while the right is a little taller and wider. Both large black pupils merge into softly arched upper lids and look left together. Keep identical lilac bands broad at the lower middle, fine near the ends, with one long narrow ivory glint per pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
